description: Retrospective approval for erection of a single-storey rear extension, air source heat pumps, and the replacement of the existing pitched roof with a flat roof on the existing single-storey rear element of the dwelling.
decision_conditions:
a) The ASHP installation shall be retained and maintained strictly in accordance with the details, specifications and mitigation measures set out in the submitted acoustic assessment (PC Environmental Ltd, Ref. 91005, dated 22/01/2026), including the approved acoustic louvred enclosure and anti vibration mountings. No deviation, alteration or substitution of plant, enclosure, mountings or operating characteristics shall take place without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.
b) The cumulative noise rating level of the ASHP plant shall be at least 5 dB(A) below the lowest measured background noise level at the nearest noise sensitive façade, when assessed in accordance with BS 4142:2014 (as amended) or any successor standard.
c) The ASHP units shall be mounted on proprietary anti vibration supports as detailed in the submitted documentation, and shall be maintained in good working order to prevent transmission of structure borne noise to the building fabric.
d) The approved acoustic louvred enclosure shall be permanently retained, kept closed during operation except for essential access, and maintained to ensure its acoustic performance is not compromised over time.
e) In the event that any ASHP unit or associated external plant is replaced, the replacement system shall not exceed the noise emission levels specified in item B of this condition, and shall comply with all mitigation measures in item A of this condition, or any updated details approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

REASON: To ensure that the development occurs in accordance with the submitted Acoustic Assessment, and, to ensure that amenity impacts as a result of the proposal are suitably mitigated.
